title: AudioDevice
description: One audio input/output device, as returned by list_input_devices / list_output_devices. Pass `id` to select_input_device / select_output_device. Mirrors Rust struct audio::AudioDevice.

id.description: Stable device identifier (currently the cpal device name). Opaque to the UI.

isDefault.description: True if this is the OS default device for its direction.

maxChannels.description: Channel count of the device's default config.
